title.en: Ban Zhao: history, teaching and women’s education
title.zh: 班昭：史学、教学与女性教育

location.label: Luoyang; representative Eastern Han court setting

summary.en:
Ban Zhao’s career joins family scholarship to the institutions of the Eastern Han court. After her brother Ban Gu died in 92, she helped complete the family’s history of the Former Han. She also taught women at court and wrote a short instructional work usually translated as Admonitions for Women. These activities make her visible as a participant in learned production, rather than only as a subject of rules about women.

Her advice accepted hierarchical relations between husbands and wives and prescribed demanding domestic conduct. At the same time, it argued that girls required education as well as boys. Those positions belonged to a particular elite moral argument; they do not describe every woman’s life or establish universal female schooling. Reading the instructions beside her historical work reveals both the constraints of gendered authority and opportunities available to an exceptionally educated woman.
summary.zh:
班昭的经历把家族学术与东汉宫廷制度联系起来。兄长班固于92年去世后，她参与续成家族撰写的《汉书》，又在宫廷教授女性，并写下通常译作《女诫》的训诫文字。这些活动显示，她不仅是女性行为规范的对象，也是学术知识生产的参与者。

她的教诲接受夫妇之间的等级关系，对家庭行为提出严格要求；与此同时，她也主张女子应像男子一样接受教育。这是特定精英环境中的伦理论说，不能当作所有女性生活的写照，也不能证明当时已经普及女学。把训诫与史学工作并读，可以同时看到性别权威的限制，以及少数受过充分教育的女性能够获得的活动空间。

title.en: Li Qingzhao: lyric voice, collecting and displacement
title.zh: 李清照：词、收藏与流离

location.label: Hangzhou; representative southern Song cultural center

summary.en:
Li Qingzhao wrote ci lyrics and prose during the transition from Northern to Southern Song. Her work demonstrates a woman’s authority within demanding literary forms, while her afterword to the epigraphic catalogue Jinshi lu records another kind of intellectual labour. She describes acquiring books and inscriptions with Zhao Mingcheng, comparing texts, organizing collections and arguing over remembered passages. Collecting was also a practice of reading, judgment and preservation.

The afterword recounts flight south in 1127, the destruction and dispersal of possessions, and her husband’s death in 1129. It connects war to the loss of a working scholarly archive, beyond changes in dynastic capitals. Her poems should nevertheless not all be treated as literal diary entries. Questions of attribution and later interpretation remain important, and differing scholarly death dates make an exact final year inappropriate as an unqualified fact.
summary.zh:
李清照在北宋向南宋转折的时代写作词与散文，显示女性能够在严格而复杂的文学形式中建立自己的声音。她为金石目录《金石录》所写的后序，还呈现了另一种知识劳动：与赵明诚购求书籍碑刻、校勘文字、整理藏品，并以记忆中的书史内容相互考问。收藏因此也是阅读、判断和保存的实践。

后序叙述了1127年南迁、藏品被毁和散失，以及1129年丈夫去世。战争由此不仅意味着都城和王朝的变化，也意味着日常使用的学术资料库遭到破坏。不过，不能把她每一首词都直接当作日记；作品归属和后世解释仍需辨析。学术资料对卒年亦有不同记载，不宜不加说明地把某一年当作确切终点。

title.en: Shen Kuo: observation across disciplines
title.zh: 沈括：跨领域的观察与记录

location.label: Zhenjiang; representative late-life writing setting

summary.en:
Shen Kuo combined official service with investigations of the natural and made environment. Surveying and water management placed technical judgment within administration, while work in the astronomical bureau involved instruments, observations and the reform of measurement. His career therefore connects the literate official to practical specialists rather than separating scholarship from material work.

The Dream Pool Essays preserve observations and reports on many subjects, including an account of Bi Sheng’s clay movable type. That passage is evidence for both the craft and the writer who recorded it; it does not make Shen the inventor of the process. His notes also show the value and limits of a compiled notebook: direct observations stand alongside information learned from others. A biography can explain these relationships more fully than an isolated publication marker, while avoiding the claim that every statement anticipated a modern science.
summary.zh:
沈括把官员生涯与对自然环境、人工设施的考察结合起来。测绘和水利工作使技术判断进入行政实践；在天文机构的任职，又涉及仪器、观测和测量方法的改进。因此，他的经历把文人官员与实际技术人员联系起来，而不是把学术与物质劳动割裂开来。

《梦溪笔谈》保存了许多领域的观察与见闻，其中包括毕昇泥活字的记载。这段文字既是印刷工艺的证据，也是记录者工作的证据，却不意味着沈括本人发明了这一工艺。笔记还显示汇编式知识的价值与限度：亲自观察的内容，与从他人处获得的信息并存。传记能够解释这些关系，超出一个孤立的成书年份，同时避免把每条记载都说成现代科学的预言。

title.en: Guo Shoujing: calendar and water systems
title.zh: 郭守敬：历法与水利系统

location.label: Beijing; representative capital and institutional setting

summary.en:
Guo Shoujing’s work linked astronomical observation with the engineering of water. Serving the Yuan government, he participated in calendar reform alongside Wang Xun and other specialists. Instruments, coordinated observations and mathematical procedures supported the Shoushi calendar introduced in 1281. The calendar was an institutional product as well as a celebrated individual achievement.

Guo also investigated irrigation and the supply of water to the capital. His later waterworks responsibilities connected local springs, channels and navigable transport with the much larger problem of provisioning Dadu. Moving grain required reliable levels, maintenance and labour; a line drawn between two places does not explain the hydraulic system. His biography therefore links to a separate capital-water context rather than treating every canal segment as his personal invention. Precise routes and changing shorelines require historical cartographic evidence beyond a modern representative point.
summary.zh:
郭守敬的工作把天文观测与水利工程联系起来。他服务于元朝政府，与王恂及其他技术人员共同参与历法改革；仪器、协同观测和数学方法，支持了1281年颁行的《授时历》。历法既是重要个人成就，也是制度与集体协作的产物。

他还考察灌溉与都城供水。后期的水利职务，把泉源、沟渠和通航条件，与大都粮食供应这一更大问题联系起来。粮运需要稳定水位、持续维护和劳动投入，连接两点的一条地图线并不能解释整个水利系统。因此，本传连接独立的都城水利背景条目，不把每段运河都说成他的个人发明。精确河道和岸线变化，还需要超出一个现代代表点的历史地图证据。

title.en: Xu Guangqi: translation and calendar reform
title.zh: 徐光启：翻译与历法改革

location.label: Shanghai; representative biographical and commemorative setting

summary.en:
Xu Guangqi worked at the meeting of Chinese official learning and knowledge carried by Jesuit scholars. In 1607 he and Matteo Ricci produced a Chinese translation of the first six books of Euclid’s Elements, drawing on the edition associated with Christopher Clavius. Translating demonstrations required decisions about vocabulary, sequence and explanation, not merely replacing one set of words with another.

Later, Xu participated in calendar reform after a comparison of eclipse predictions in 1629. This undertaking involved several technical traditions and the practical authority of state astronomy. His career can therefore be read as selective collaboration within existing Chinese institutions, rather than a simple replacement of one civilization’s knowledge by another. Shanghai is a representative biographical anchor; the translation and calendar milestones are located at Beijing. The selected achievements also connect mathematical argument to the training, patronage and administrative purposes that made sustained exchange possible.
summary.zh:
徐光启的工作处于中国官学与耶稣会士所携知识相遇的环境中。1607年，他与利玛窦依据克拉维相关版本，合译欧几里得《几何原本》前六卷。翻译论证过程，需要选择术语、安排次序和解释推理，并非把一套词汇机械地替换成另一套。

1629年日食预报比较之后，他又参与历法改革。这项工作涉及多种技术传统，也关系到国家天文学的实际权威。因此，可以把他的经历理解为既有中国制度中的选择性合作，而不是一种文明的知识简单取代另一种。上海是传记的代表性地理锚点；翻译与修历节点则标在北京。这些成就也把数学论证与训练、资助和行政用途联系起来，说明持续交流需要怎样的条件。

title.en: Tu Youyou: research, collaboration and recognition
title.zh: 屠呦呦：研究、协作与认可

location.label: Beijing; representative capital and institutional setting

summary.en:
Tu Youyou’s research connected pharmaceutical training, historical medical texts and experimental work on malaria. In 1969 she took a leading role in a research group within the wider Project 523 effort. Examining older descriptions of qinghao informed questions about preparation, but the identification of artemisinin also required extraction, testing, chemical work and collaboration across institutions. A traditional reference was a research lead, not by itself proof of a compound’s properties.

The 2015 Nobel Prize recognized her contribution to the discovery. That recognition should be placed beside the collective and institutional history of the research, rather than erasing either individual initiative or the work of colleagues. This entry follows a research career to an award, without treating that award as the end of her life. Her story brings women’s scientific labour and twentieth-century institutions into a history that crossed national boundaries through later recognition and discussion.
summary.zh:
屠呦呦的研究把药学训练、历史医籍与疟疾实验联系起来。1969年，她在更广泛的“523”科研工作中担任研究组负责人。对古代青蒿记载的考察，为制备方法提出问题；但青蒿素的发现仍需要提取、实验检验、化学研究和跨机构合作。传统文献提供的是研究线索，并不单独构成对化合物性质的证明。

2015年诺贝尔奖表彰了她对这一发现的贡献。理解这一认可，需要同时保留个人主动性和同事、机构共同工作的历史。本条追踪科研活动至获奖，并不把获奖当作生命终点。她的经历使女性科研劳动与二十世纪的制度进入历史叙述；后续的认可和讨论，又让这一历史跨越国界。

summary.en:
The growing importance of rice in the Song economy depended on work as much as on a new seed. Early-ripening and drought-resistant varieties associated with Champa could extend possibilities for cultivation, while irrigation and terracing changed where crops could grow. In suitable southern environments, crop calendars could combine more than one harvest or different seasonal crops. These possibilities did not make every field equally productive.

Preparing paddies, maintaining ditches, transplanting seedlings, weeding and processing grain demanded sustained labour. Rivers also made shipment to towns and markets easier, helping some regions specialize. Northern communities continued to depend heavily on other grains, so the southern rice story cannot stand for all of China. Linking agriculture with cities makes the food supply visible behind urban prosperity, while later tilling scrolls preserve an artistic tradition rather than measured Song yields or every worker’s experience.
summary.zh:
稻米在宋代经济中日益重要，依靠的不只是新品种，也依靠劳动。与占城有关的早熟、耐旱稻种，扩大了部分地区的种植可能；灌溉和梯田又改变了适宜耕作的空间。南方某些环境可以安排多次收获，或轮作不同季节作物，但这并不意味着所有田地具有相同产量。

整治水田、维护沟渠、插秧、除草和加工粮食，都需要持续投入劳动。河流便利粮食运往城镇和市场，也帮助部分地区形成专业化生产。北方人群仍主要依靠其他谷物，不能用南方稻作概括整个中国。把农业与城市联系起来，可以看见繁荣背后的食物供应；而后世耕作画卷保存的是艺术传统，并非宋代产量统计或每位劳动者处境的记录。

title.en: Song cities: streets, services and unequal prosperity
title.zh: 宋代城市：街市、服务与不均等的繁荣

location.label: Hangzhou; representative southern Song cultural center

summary.en:
Song capitals and commercial towns brought shops, food sellers, transport workers and customers into dense everyday contact. Accounts of Kaifeng and Hangzhou describe an urban life in which trade and entertainment extended beyond a strictly bounded official market. The painted riverside city is useful evidence for imagined and observed urban relationships, but it is not a complete map or an exact population count.

City life depended on food, fuel, raw materials and labour arriving from a wider countryside. Commercial specialization joined the fortunes of urban consumers to those of cultivators, boat crews and artisans. Prosperity also coexisted with poverty, prompting charitable and governmental relief measures. Looking at these services alongside fashionable consumption prevents the city from becoming only a spectacle of wealthy shoppers. A representative capital helps orient the account; many smaller places participated in these networks on different terms.
summary.zh:
宋代都城与商业城镇，使店主、食物摊贩、运输劳动者和顾客在日常生活中密集接触。关于开封和杭州的记载，呈现了超出严格封闭官市范围的贸易与娱乐活动。河畔城市画卷可以帮助观察城市关系及其表现方式，却不是完整地图，也不是精确的人口统计。

城市依赖更广大乡村供应粮食、燃料、原料和劳动力。商业专业化把消费者与种植者、船工、工匠的生活联系起来。繁荣同时伴随贫困，因而也出现慈善和政府救济。把这些服务与消费并读，可以避免把城市仅仅表现为富裕购物者的景观。都城坐标提供方向，许多较小聚落也以不同条件参与这些网络。

title.en: Song money: paper promises and public authority
title.zh: 宋代货币：纸面信用与公共权力

location.label: Chengdu; representative early paper-money setting

summary.en:
Paper currency emerged from the practical difficulties of moving and paying large quantities of metal money. Merchant instruments and later government issues depended on acceptance, redemption arrangements and confidence in the issuer. Their history is therefore a story of commercial organization and public authority, not simply the discovery that writing a number on paper could replace coins.

Different kinds of money continued to coexist, and conditions varied between regions and periods. Later Yuan and Ming paper currencies extended the history without making their institutions identical to Song practices. A Ming note preserved in the British Museum expresses value through an image of coin strings, showing how paper could refer to older monetary forms. That object is a later comparison rather than a surviving Song note. Keeping these distinctions visible prevents a useful museum illustration from becoming false evidence for an earlier issue.
summary.zh:
纸币的出现，与大量金属货币运输和支付的不便有关。商人使用的凭券，以及后来的政府发行，都依赖接受范围、兑现安排和对发行者的信任。因此，这不仅是发现“在纸上写个数字就能代替钱”的故事，也涉及商业组织和公共权力。

不同货币继续并存，各地各时期的条件也不相同。元、明纸币延续了这一历史，却不意味着它们与宋代制度完全一致。大英博物馆保存的一张明代纸钞，用钱串图像表达价值，显示纸面货币如何援引旧有货币形式。这件实物只是较晚的比较材料，并非宋代遗钞。保持这些区别，可以避免把有用的博物馆图像误当作更早发行的直接证据。

title.en: Song textiles: household work and skilled workshops
title.zh: 宋代纺织：家庭劳动与专业作坊

location.label: Lower Yangzi; representative textile-producing setting

summary.en:
Silk’s prestige can hide the many stages of labour that made cloth possible. Feeding silkworms, tending trays, handling cocoons and preparing thread required repeated household work, often performed by women. Complex patterned fabrics also depended on skilled professional weaving in official and private workshops. These tasks belonged to connected settings rather than one uniform factory system.

Most people did not dress exclusively in luxurious silk: hemp, ramie and, increasingly toward the end of the period, cotton also mattered. A painted sericulture handscroll offers a carefully composed image of production, not an unmediated record of every worker’s conditions. Reading it beside written accounts helps ask whose effort was celebrated, organized or left unnamed. The resulting history connects elite garments and traded goods to ordinary maintenance work, while allowing divisions of skill and gender to differ across households and workshops.
summary.zh:
丝织品的声望容易遮蔽成布之前的多重劳动。养蚕、清理蚕盘、处理蚕茧与准备丝线，需要反复进行的家庭工作，往往由女性承担。复杂花纹织物还依靠官营或私营作坊中的专业织工。这些工作属于相互联系的不同环境，并非统一的工厂体系。

多数人并不全穿华贵丝绸，麻、苎麻以及宋末日益重要的棉也参与日常衣着。蚕织画卷提供的是经过组织的生产图像，不是每位劳动者处境的直接记录。把画面与文字记载并读，有助于追问哪些劳动被赞颂、被组织，哪些劳动者没有留下姓名。这样的历史把精英服饰和贸易商品与普通日常维护连接起来，同时允许家庭和作坊中的技能、性别分工存在差异。

title.en: Song examinations: learning, office and exclusion
title.zh: 宋代科举：学习、仕途与门槛

location.label: Kaifeng; representative Northern Song examination setting

summary.en:
The Song examination system made learned performance an important route to official status and public prestige. Preparation joined reading, composition, teaching and family investment. Measures such as copying scripts and concealing candidates’ names sought to limit particular forms of favoritism, but procedures did not give everyone the same resources with which to compete.

Education required time, books and support, and many candidates failed to obtain the highest qualifications or a government post. Literate aspirations therefore extended beyond the bureaucracy into teaching, collecting, writing and artistic practice. These connections help explain why an examination record is also part of social and cultural history. The system did not suddenly create all learning in 960, nor were all offices filled by one identical route. Its Song development should be related to earlier institutions and later changes rather than stretched into an unchanging thousand-year meritocracy.
summary.zh:
宋代科举使学业表现成为取得官员身份与社会声望的重要途径。备考把阅读、写作、教学和家庭投入联系起来。誊录试卷、遮隐姓名等办法，试图减少某些徇私方式，但程序并不能让所有应试者拥有同等的竞争资源。

学习需要时间、书籍和供养，许多人无法取得最高功名或官职。因此，文人的志向也延伸到官僚机构之外，包括授徒、收藏、著述和艺术活动。这些联系说明，科举记录同时属于社会史与文化史。960年并不是所有学习活动的突然起点，也并非全部官职只有一种任用途径。宋代发展需要与前代制度和后世变化联系起来，而不应被拉长成千年不变的公平选才机制。

title.en: Song books: carving, copying and readers
title.zh: 宋代书籍：刻印、传抄与读者

location.label: Kaifeng; representative publishing and reading setting

summary.en:
Making books involved authors and readers, but also paper makers, scribes, block cutters, printers and patrons. Woodblock production could multiply a text while demanding substantial preparation and skilled labour. Movable type offered another method without immediately displacing blocks. The persistence of several techniques matters more than a simple succession in which each new invention erased its predecessor.

Printed religious works, practical knowledge and literary texts circulated in overlapping settings. More copies could widen access, although possessing a book did not remove differences in schooling, income or reading ability. Shen Kuo’s description of Bi Sheng is itself an example of knowledge about a craft surviving through writing. Li Qingzhao’s account of collecting and collation shows another part of the book’s social life. Together these connections turn publication from an isolated date into a history of production, preservation and use.
summary.zh:
书籍的制作不仅涉及作者和读者，也涉及造纸者、抄手、刻工、印工与资助者。雕版能够复制文字，却需要大量前期准备和专业劳动。活字提供了另一种方法，但没有立即淘汰雕版。多种技术长期并存，比“新发明自动取代旧技术”的直线叙述更能解释实际情况。

宗教、实用知识和文学书籍在相互重叠的环境中流通。副本增加可以扩大接触机会，却不能消除教育、收入和阅读能力的差别。沈括记述毕昇，本身就是工艺知识通过文字保存的例子；李清照关于收藏与校勘的叙述，又呈现了书籍社会生活的另一部分。这些联系把出版从孤立年份，转化为生产、保存和使用的历史。

title.en: Jingdezhen: porcelain materials and workshop skill
title.zh: 景德镇：瓷土、窑火与作坊技艺

location.label: Jingdezhen; representative porcelain production center

summary.en:
Porcelain production at Jingdezhen joined the properties of ceramic materials to firing knowledge, decoration and organized labour. Blue-and-white wares placed cobalt decoration beneath a transparent glaze, but their appearance depended on the interaction of pigment, body and kiln conditions. A finished vessel therefore embodies many judgments that a dynastic label alone cannot explain.

Imperial patronage was important without accounting for every workshop or customer. The late-sixteenth-century kendi in the Metropolitan Museum demonstrates a form made in China for use in connected Asian markets, including Muslim communities in Southeast Asia. Production could respond to expectations outside the court, and forms acquired meanings through use as well as manufacture. This context complements existing Jingdezhen date markers by following the relationships between material, skill, patronage and demand. It does not assign all ceramics of the period to a single kiln or a uniform labour regime.
summary.zh:
景德镇制瓷把陶瓷材料的性质，与烧成知识、装饰及劳动组织结合起来。青花将钴料装饰置于透明釉下，但最终效果取决于颜料、胎体和窑炉条件的相互作用。一件成品因此包含许多技术判断，不能仅靠王朝标签来解释。

宫廷资助很重要，却不能概括所有作坊和顾客。大都会艺术博物馆收藏的十六世纪末军持，显示中国制作的器形如何服务于相联系的亚洲市场，包括东南亚穆斯林群体。生产可以回应宫廷之外的需要，器物意义也在使用而不只在制造中形成。本条通过材料、技能、资助与需求之间的关系，补充既有景德镇年代标记，不把同代全部陶瓷归于一座窑或一种劳动制度。

title.en: Porcelain across seas: Asian markets and European commissions
title.zh: 瓷器越海：亚洲市场与欧洲订制

location.label: Quanzhou; representative long-lived maritime connection, not sole export port

summary.en:
Chinese porcelain circulated through Asian networks before European demand became a major part of its history. Drinking vessels, dishes and decorative forms could be adapted to different habits and expectations. The kendi’s Southeast Asian and Muslim associations make those connections visible without treating every object as a product designed for a European table.

From the later sixteenth century, expanding European purchases and maritime companies added customers, intermediaries and commissioned forms. Some designs crossed between media and regions; eighteenth-century armorial wares made particular patrons’ identities part of the decoration. Such circulation was not a one-way spread of an unchanged Chinese style. Producers interpreted orders, customers repurposed objects, and competing workshops copied successful designs. A port marker represents a maritime network, not a claim that all export porcelain left from that harbour or followed the same route.
summary.zh:
欧洲需求成为重要因素之前，中国瓷器已经通过亚洲网络流通。饮水器、盘碟和装饰器形，可以适应不同的生活习惯与期待。军持与东南亚及穆斯林使用环境的联系，使这些关系具体可见，也避免把每件器物都理解为专为欧洲餐桌设计。

十六世纪后期起，欧洲购买与海运公司的扩展，增加了客户、中间商和订制器形。某些图样跨越材料与地区，十八世纪的纹章瓷又把特定赞助者的身份纳入装饰。这不是不变“中国风格”的单向传播：生产者解释订单，顾客改变用途，竞争作坊模仿成功图样。港口标记代表海上网络，不表示全部外销瓷都从这一港口出海或采用同一路线。

title.en: Honghe Hani terraces: water, forests and community work
title.zh: 红河哈尼梯田：水、森林与社区劳动

location.label: Honghe Hani Rice Terraces; representative landscape point

summary.en:
The Honghe Hani landscape connects mountain forests, settlements, channels and cultivated terraces. Water moves through a managed environment whose maintenance depends on social arrangements as well as gravity. Rice cultivation has been combined with animals and aquatic resources, while ritual and community institutions help organize responsibilities. The visible terraces are thus part of a broader inhabited system.

UNESCO describes roughly thirteen centuries of development, but that rounded history does not identify a single founding year. The selected interval offers a later historical focus through inscription in 2013, not the complete duration of Hani life or the end of agricultural practice. An official heritage dossier makes the relationships legible while tending to emphasize continuity and coherence. It should not be mistaken for proof that every household shared the same experience or that the landscape remained unchanged under economic and environmental pressure.
summary.zh:
红河哈尼景观把山地森林、村寨、沟渠和梯田联系起来。水流穿过经过管理的环境，其维持既依靠地势，也依靠社会安排。稻作与家畜、水生资源利用结合，仪式和社区制度则帮助组织责任。因此，可见梯田属于一个更广泛、有人居住和劳动的系统。

联合国教科文组织介绍约十三个世纪的发展，但这一概数不能确定某个建成年。这里选择较晚的历史关注阶段，至2013年列入世界遗产为止，不表示哈尼生活的全部时长，也不表示农业活动终止。官方遗产档案有助于理解整体关系，同时倾向强调延续与协调，不能由此证明每户人家的经验相同，或景观在经济和环境压力下从未变化。

dateNote.en: Approximate focus c.1300–2013; 1300 is a selected display boundary, not a founding date. 2013 is UNESCO inscription, not cultural disappearance.

title.en: Fujian tulou: communal houses and agricultural lives
title.zh: 福建土楼：共同居住与农业生活

location.label: Fujian Tulou; representative building-group point

summary.en:
Fujian tulou are large earthen residential buildings whose circular or rectangular forms organize shared space around an inward-facing center. Defensive features, entrances, internal circulation and family arrangements shaped how people lived together. Their agricultural surroundings matter as much as the striking exterior: these were inhabited homes connected with cultivation, storage and everyday work.

The UNESCO property includes forty-six buildings, described chiefly within a fifteenth- to twentieth-century range. That selected group should not be equated with every earthen building in Fujian or the full history of its inhabitants. Architectural resemblance also does not establish that all residents belonged to one identical community. Reading plans, materials and setting together can connect household organization with resources and security. The map uses one representative point for a dispersed property, while the displayed interval follows a broad building period rather than a precise date when communal life began or ended.
summary.zh:
福建土楼以大型夯土住宅的形式，把共同空间组织在向内的中心周围，外形可呈圆形或方形。防御设施、入口、内部通行与家庭安排，共同影响居住方式。农业环境与醒目的外观同样重要：土楼是有人生活的住宅，与耕作、储藏和日常劳动相联系。

世界遗产项目包含四十六座建筑，主要年代范围为十五至二十世纪。这一入选群体不能等同于福建所有土建筑，也不能概括居民的全部历史。建筑相似也不证明居民都属于完全相同的社区。把平面、材料和环境并读，可以把家庭组织与资源、安全联系起来。地图以一个点代表分散建筑群，显示区间采用宽泛建造时期，而非共同生活开始或结束的精确日期。

dateNote.en: Broad building-period focus, fifteenth–twentieth centuries, displayed as 1400–2000; neither date is a foundation or abandonment claim.

title.en: Tusi institutions: local authority and imperial negotiation
title.zh: 土司制度：地方权力与帝国协商

location.label: Laosicheng; representative Tusi heritage site

summary.en:
Tusi institutions joined hereditary local leadership with appointments and recognition from imperial governments. The relationship could involve titles, obligations, jurisdiction and competing claims to authority. It was neither identical to direct county administration nor a single independent state with one boundary. Different places and periods require their own political histories.

The UNESCO grouping of Laosicheng, Tangya and Hailongtun preserves administrative, residential, ceremonial and defensive evidence. Layouts and building forms show interactions between local practices and imperial symbols. An official heritage narrative emphasizes connection and accommodation, but material combination alone does not prove that relations were always peaceful or consensual. Examining institutions alongside community experience helps explain both negotiated rule and unequal power. This entry supplies a regional framework for individual fortresses and campaigns without turning every monument into a separate dynasty or projecting present administrative categories backward unchanged.
summary.zh:
土司制度把世袭地方首领，与帝国政府的任命和承认联系起来。这种关系涉及名号、义务、司法权限和相互竞争的权威主张。它既不等同于直接的州县行政，也不是拥有单一边界的独立国家；不同地点与时期都需要各自的政治史。

老司城、唐崖和海龙屯组成的世界遗产，保存了行政、居住、仪式和防御方面的证据。布局与建筑形式显示地方实践同帝国符号之间的互动。官方遗产叙述强调联系和调适，但物质形式的结合本身，不能证明关系始终和平或出于一致同意。把制度与社区经验并读，才能同时解释协商统治与不平等权力。本条为具体城堡和战争提供区域框架，不把每处遗址变成一个王朝，也不把今天的行政类别原样投射到过去。

title.en: Kaiping diaolou: migration, remittances and home
title.zh: 开平碉楼：迁徙、侨汇与家园

location.label: Kaiping; representative diaolou village setting

summary.en:
Kaiping’s tower houses connect village security and domestic ambition with migration across oceans. Overseas Chinese communities in different destinations helped finance buildings that combined local construction practices with architectural forms encountered abroad. Remittances could become rooms, decorated facades and visible statements about a household’s connections. Migration therefore changed the landscape of home as well as the places where migrants worked.

Diaolou served several purposes: some provided shared refuge, others were residential towers or watchtowers. Those functions should not be collapsed into a single story of wealthy private houses. UNESCO’s selected villages and buildings document an especially prominent late-nineteenth- and early-twentieth-century phase, within longer building traditions. The chosen endpoint is a historical focus rather than a claim that migration or construction ceased in 1937. A representative village location helps readers connect built form, overseas labour and family strategies without inventing a route for every migrant.
summary.zh:
开平碉楼把村落安全、居住愿望与越洋迁徙联系起来。分布在不同目的地的华侨群体，资助建造融合本地营造方法与海外所见建筑形式的房屋。侨汇因此转化为房间、装饰立面，以及显示家庭联系的可见标志。迁徙不仅改变侨民工作的地方，也改变家乡景观。

碉楼具有多种用途：有些供共同避难，有些是居住楼或更楼，不能全部压缩成富裕私人住宅的故事。世界遗产选取的村落和建筑，记录了十九世纪末至二十世纪初尤为突出的发展阶段，其背后还有更长的建造传统。1937年是本条关注范围的终点，不表示迁徙或营建就此停止。代表性村落点帮助联系建筑、海外劳动和家庭策略，不虚构每位移民的具体路线。

title.en: Yuan Dadu: water supply and grain transport
title.zh: 元大都：供水与粮运

location.label: Beijing; representative capital and institutional setting

summary.en:
Supplying Yuan Dadu required more than a road or canal drawn toward the capital. Water had to reach the city and navigable connections had to sustain the movement of bulky grain. Springs, channels, levels and the coordination of transport belonged to an engineered and administered system. Local hydraulic work therefore needs to be read alongside the much larger Grand Canal network.

Guo Shoujing’s astronomical responsibilities overlapped a career in water engineering, and his waterworks office in 1292 provides a dated institutional anchor. The broader canal network accumulated work from different governments and communities; it cannot all be assigned to one engineer or one completion year. This focused context explains the relationship between capital provisioning and water control. Its representative point locates the capital, while channel alignments, seasonal water availability and construction phases remain questions for historical maps and detailed engineering evidence rather than invented geometry.
summary.zh:
元大都的供给，不能只靠一条朝向都城的道路或运河线来解释。水必须进入城市，通航连接也必须支持大宗粮食运输。泉源、沟渠、水位和运输协调，属于经过工程建设与行政管理的系统。因此，地方水利需要同更广大的大运河网络一起理解。

郭守敬的天文职责，与水利工程生涯有所交叠；1292年的水利职务提供了一个有年代依据的制度节点。更广泛的运河网络积累了不同政府和社区的劳动，不能全部归于一位工程师或一个竣工年份。本条解释都城供给与水控制之间的关系。代表点标示都城；河道走向、季节水量与施工阶段，仍需历史地图和具体工程证据回答，不能用虚构几何线代替。

title.en: New Culture: public learning and contested change
title.zh: 新文化：公共学习与变革争论

location.label: Beijing; representative capital and institutional setting

summary.en:
The New Culture movement brought arguments about learning, ethics, literature and citizenship into journals, schools and public debate. It was broader than the student demonstration of 4 May 1919, although that protest helped connect cultural criticism with political mobilization. The debate over how people should learn and speak publicly involved different proposals, rather than one agreed blueprint for a new society.

Columbia’s translated primary selections place Chen Duxiu, Hu Shi and other writers alongside one another, making disagreement part of the evidence. Calls for change could challenge inherited authority while drawing on existing institutions and intellectual resources. Attention to publishing and education also asks who could participate: printed argument did not automatically reach every rural household or overcome inequalities in schooling. Following these questions supplies a social context for political milestones and helps distinguish influential reformist claims from a complete account of everyday experience.
summary.zh:
新文化运动把学习、伦理、文学和公民身份问题，带入期刊、学校与公共争论。它的范围超过1919年5月4日的学生示威，尽管示威推动文化批评与政治动员相联系。关于如何学习、如何面向公众表达的讨论，包含不同方案，并非所有人认可同一幅新社会蓝图。

哥伦比亚大学选译陈独秀、胡适等人的原始文字，使意见差异成为证据的一部分。变革主张可以挑战既有权威，同时依靠已有制度与思想资源。关注出版和教育，还需要追问谁能够参与：印刷论说不会自动到达每户农村家庭，也不会自动克服教育差距。这些问题为政治节点补充社会背景，并帮助区分有影响的改革主张与完整的日常生活描述。

title.en: 1950 marriage reform: law, posters and practice
title.zh: 1950年婚姻改革：法律、宣传画与实践

location.label: Beijing; representative capital and institutional setting

summary.en:
The 1950 Marriage Law presented free choice of partner, monogamy, equal rights and protection of women and children as principles of a new family order. Registration also connected intimate relationships with state institutions. Posters translated these claims into accessible scenes of partnership and contrasted a promised future with condemned features of the old order.

The existence of a law or an optimistic image does not establish uniform implementation. Campaigns, local officials, family interests and marriage disputes shaped how reform was encountered, and publicity continued through the early 1950s. A surviving 1950 poster is therefore primary evidence for the language and imagery of mobilization, rather than proof that all depicted improvements had occurred. Reading legal aspirations alongside the research guide’s account of conflict makes women and family visible within modern political history. This is a historical campaign context, not a description of the law currently in force.
summary.zh:
1950年《婚姻法》把婚姻自主、一夫一妻、男女平等以及保护妇女儿童，作为新家庭秩序的原则。登记又把亲密关系与国家机构联系起来。宣传画将这些主张转化为易于理解的伴侣图景，并把承诺中的未来与受到谴责的旧秩序特征相对照。

法律存在或画面乐观，并不能证明实施处处一致。运动、地方干部、家庭利益与婚姻纠纷，共同影响人们如何遭遇改革；宣传在1950年代初持续进行。因此，一张1950年宣传画，是动员语言与图像的原始证据，而不是所有改善均已实现的证明。把法律理想与研究导引对冲突的讨论并读，可以在现代政治史中看见妇女和家庭。本条讨论历史运动，不描述今天现行法律。
